g.text: Spott - Fixed-Area Search, Departure Report and Occupancy Feedback
The backend validates each write against current state and server time.
Device suggestions always require explicit driver confirmation.
Start a search around a chosen point
Moving the phone does not move the search center.
A new center or radius requires an explicit user action.
[Each eligible search with push permission and opt-in]
Reuse fixed-area matching and permitted alert delivery
[Active, unexpired report AND fresh, accurate, nearby evidence]
[Evidence missing, stale, inaccurate, distant or report already closed]
Rejected feedback does not change the report.
Live queries exclude overdue reports even before expiry processing runs.
Already dispatched alerts can arrive late; opening one rechecks the report.
Timeout and proximity values are configurable, not fixed by this diagram.
